name: 555cider-agent-skills
description: Agent skills shared across coding-agent harnesses: durable memory, plan graph, peer review, UI audit, DOM picker, screen map, worktree lifecycle, step-back.

plugins.name: agent-skills
plugins.description: Every skill in this collection at once. Install this OR the individual plugins below, never both.

plugins.name: agent-memory
plugins.description: Evidence-aware durable memory shared across Claude, Codex, and OpenCode, authoritative in SQLite, with redacted observation and lifecycle review.

plugins.name: plan-graph
plugins.description: Persistent plan context per repository: explicit prerequisites, replacement lineage, and pruning of closed plan trees through a transactional CLI.

plugins.name: peer-review
plugins.description: Second opinion on a plan, spec, or option set from other reviewer CLIs (codex, claude, opencode, agy) run in parallel and saved to the repository.

plugins.name: ui-audit
plugins.description: Visual QA gate that measures the live DOM first — contrast, overflow, focus, target size, widget contracts — before any screen is called done.

plugins.name: dom-picker
plugins.description: Turn a UI issue pointed at in a running web app into a minimal source edit, verified on the same element in Chromium.

plugins.name: screen-map
plugins.description: Agent-readable map of a web app: which screens exist and the concrete action that moves between any two, built by crawling or by recording a browser someone else drives.

plugins.name: worktree-cycle
plugins.description: Git worktree lifecycle as two guarded scripts: start branches from the local integration branch and reserves a dev-server port block; finish squash-merges and cleans up. Never pushes.

plugins.name: step-back
plugins.description: Countable tripwires that force a reassessment before work is declared done, and before effort stops being proportional to the job.
